budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported the capital plan was reduced, with the lower-priority half of the prior plan removed.
budget_items.quote: the capital plan has been reduced to $664,800.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free cash and expenditures were revised to reflect changes in the capital plan.
budget_items.quote: free cash and expenditures have been revised to reflect changes in the capital plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A revised school budget was forthcoming, reflecting a 1.58 percent increase, or a reduction from the previous budget.
budget_items.quote: a revised school budget is forthcoming, which will reflect a 1.58 percent increase, or a $192,157 reduction from the previous budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The budget was brought to a surplus, assuming state aid is level-funded though it is anticipated to be reduced.
budget_items.quote: this brings the budget to a $812,913 surplus

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager would review an OPEB contribution reduction with the town financial advisor; an extended discussion on effects of not following the annual OPEB contribution policy followed.
budget_items.quote: the town manager outlined that she would review opeb contribution

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The BOS kept the tax payment deadline but deferred any penalties and interest until June 29th (reported by the Town Manager).
budget_items.quote: the bos voted to keep the deadline for tax payments, but defer any penalties and interest until june 29th.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The BOS voted to request unappropriated expenditures related to Covid-19 costs from the Director of Accounts of the Department of Local Services (reported by the Town Manager).
budget_items.quote: the bos voted to request $100,000 in unappropriated expenditures

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Approximately $32K in Covid-related expenditures had been incurred so far.
budget_items.quote: currently there have been approximately $32k in related expenditures.
